findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure JWT validation
 * @description JWT verification without proper algorithm specification or with disabled verification
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-jwt-validation
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-347
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("jwt").getMember(["decode", "verify"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("google.auth.jwt").getMember(["decode", "verify"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "JWT decode/verify call that may be vulnerable to algorithm confusion or signature bypass if not properly configured."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure JWT validation that could lead to algorithm confusion or signature verification bypass

message.text: JWT decode/verify call that may be vulnerable to algorithm confusion or signature bypass if not properly configured.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection Detection
 * @description Detection of command execution functions that could be vulnerable to injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "run"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("platform").getMember("system").getACall()
  )
select call, "Command execution function that could be vulnerable to injection if arguments are user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection vulnerabilities via os.system or subprocess calls
